spec.kitLine: After 12 normal attacks: Cover HP restore
spec.assertion: Audit-only: the line must appear either as a hitCount:12 block or in note/unmodeled (no silent drop). Damage assertion it.skip'd - v1 has no cover-HP pool, and whether COVER recovery fires on-recovery consumers (as unit-HP recovery does) is measurement-gated. Nearest-wrong it cannot separate: cover restore modeled as a unit heal, which would over-feed crown.

Proves the line is present but requiresShielded-gated: zero coreDamagePct~85.17 buffApply from naga in the control comp, and deleting the gated blocks leaves per-slug totals byte-identical (no leakage). Fails under the nearest-wrong 'ungated/passive' model (buff fires, board lifts). The companion test deletes requiresShielded and REQUIRES the buff to appear - so it also fails under the other nearest-wrong, the line being dropped to unmodeled (patch would be a no-op).

Distinct targetSlug count === 2 pins alliesTopAtk{count:2}; fails at 4 under the nearest-wrong {kind:'allies'}. Activation count bounded to [8,120] pins ROUND counting; a pellet-counting hitCount (hitsPerShot 10) yields ~320 and fails the ceiling. Raising count 5->200 must lower team damage (fails if the trigger is not really hitCount:5). Collapsing durationSec 5->0.2 must lower team damage (fails if the buff was authored without a duration).

Structural: a heal effect must exist. Behavioural: with helm's heals stripped, naga's heal is crown's ONLY recovery source, so stripping it too must cost team damage. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'defensive line, skip on isolation' - the two runs would score identically.

Structural: a gainPierce effect with durationSec 10 must exist, and no top-level/slot-level hasPierce may be true. Fails under both nearest-wrongs: hasPierce:true (whole-fight tagging) and gainPierce with no durationSec (continuous). Damage-side test it.skip'd: pierceDamagePct is inert in v1 and no comp member consumes Pierce tagging.

spec.kitLine: All allies: ATK +16.18% of user ATK, 10s
spec.assertion: Asserts casterAtkPct applies from casterIdx===naga with exactly ONE flat magnitude and 4 distinct targets. Fails at 3 targets under the nearest-wrong excludeSelf, and at 2 magnitudes if the shield branch is ungated. Extending durationSec 10->60 must raise team damage, so an authored-without-duration (permanent) model fails.

spec.kitLine: Shield set: ATK +31.02% of user ATK, 10s
spec.assertion: Unshielded: no casterAtkPct event at v*(31.02/16.18) - fails if the gate is missing. Ungated run: exactly TWO distinct flat magnitudes whose ratio is 31.02/16.18 (1.917) - this pins both kit magnitudes relative to each other without knowing naga's sheet ATK, and fails if the branch is absent, merged into the 16.18% line, or authored at a different percentage.

fixtures: controlComp('naga', true) => liter(B1) / crown(B2) / naga / helm(B3), boss Fire, deterministic (no seed). helm=true is mandatory: naga is a Burst II, so a helm-less comp has no Burst III and reaches ZERO Full Bursts, which would make every burst-window assertion vacuous. crown is load-bearing for the s2b heal line (she is the 'when recovery takes effect' consumer). Two derived fixtures via withPatchedOverride('helm', ...) strip helm's heal effects so naga's heal is crown's sole recovery source (isolation for the heal test). 8 hoisted 180s runs total: base, shield-ungated, shield-blocks-deleted, burst-ATK-60s, core-trigger-200, core-duration-0.2s, helm-dry, helm+naga-dry. Override files are read through a shape-agnostic accessor (slot -> Block[] or slot -> {blocks}) so the counterfactuals apply under either layout.
gaps: skill1 'Restores 14.57% of Cover HP' - it.skip: v1 models no cover-HP pool, and whether cover recovery (vs unit-HP recovery) should fire on-recovery consumers like crown is measurement-gated. Only the no-silent-drop audit assertion runs.

burst 'Gains Pierce for 10 sec' damage effect - it.skip: pierceDamagePct is inert in v1 and no control-comp member carries a Pierce Damage buff, so the 10s window has no damage-side observable. Encoding is asserted structurally instead.

skill2 heal MAGNITUDE (9.58% of caster final Max HP) - unobservable: the heal effect carries no HP amount in the schema and the v1 boss deals no damage, so only the recovery EVENT (not its size) is testable.

Buff expiry FRAMES - buffApply carries expiresFrame but no apply frame, and the engine emits no buffRemove on natural lapse, so both 'for 10 sec' and 'for 5 sec' are proven by counterfactual duration patches (score must move) rather than by a removal-frame assertion.
